advancements.forgotten.boss_author.descr: Shake the Author's conviction until it asks.
advancements.forgotten.boss_author.title: The Question
advancements.forgotten.boss_curator.desc: Defeat the Curator in the Archive.
advancements.forgotten.boss_king_of_yest: Defeat the King of Yesterday without repeating yourself.
advancements.forgotten.boss_unwrapper.de: Feed the Unwrapper until it cannot move.
advancements.forgotten.depth.description: Step through a Frame Anchor into a copy of the world.
advancements.forgotten.depth.title: Matryoshka
End this run. The next world will remember it.
advancements.forgotten.first_word.descri: Decode a word of the world's language.
advancements.forgotten.first_word.title: The World Speaks
advancements.forgotten.infinite_loop.des: Compile a program that never lets time pass.
advancements.forgotten.lens.description: Look at the seams of the world.
advancements.forgotten.lens.title: Through the Lens
advancements.forgotten.paradox_engine.de: Contradict reality with the Paradox Engine.
advancements.forgotten.rank_2.title: Patchmaker
advancements.forgotten.rank_3.title: Rewriter
advancements.forgotten.rank_4.title: Architect
advancements.forgotten.rank_5.title: Paradox Lord
advancements.forgotten.scratch_layer.des: Reach the deepest copy, where generation has given up.
advancements.forgotten.something_is_wron: Witness the world make a mistake.
advancements.forgotten.the_archive.descr: Hold a Lens to a written book on a lectern and enter the Archive.
advancements.forgotten.the_archive.title: Everything That Happened
advancements.forgotten.the_backside.desc: Fall through forgotten ground into the Backside.
advancements.forgotten.the_backside.titl: The Other Side of the Floor
advancements.forgotten.the_crash.descrip: Unmake a region with the Crash.
advancements.forgotten.the_crash.title: Segmentation Fault
advancements.forgotten.the_stack.descrip: Open a rift with an Infinite Loop and enter the Stack.
advancements.forgotten.the_stack.title: Stack Overflow
advancements.forgotten.the_underdream.de: Sleep through a thunderstorm and wake in the Underdream.
advancements.forgotten.the_workshop.desc: Reach the Workshop below the Scratch Layer.
block.forgotten.compiler_chest.desc: Lay items out one instruction per row, a wafer in the last slot, and close it. It compiles.
block.forgotten.core_of_identity.desc: The centre of a Reality Architecture. Chambers within 32 blocks answer to it.
block.forgotten.data_block.desc: A block of the Stack: memory that glows where it is being read.
block.forgotten.distance_chamber.desc: Join two with an ender pearl; step on one to step out of the other, anywhere. Needs a Core of Identity.
block.forgotten.final_block.desc: Identity + Finality. It will always be what it is. Nothing can transform it.
block.forgotten.frame_anchor.desc: Use to step one depth down into a copy of the world where time runs faster. Crouch-use inside a depth to climb back.
block.forgotten.genesis_interface.desc: Feed it Source Code to summon the Author. Once it has asked its question, it writes the rules, the laws and the ending.
block.forgotten.gravity_chamber.desc: Within 6 blocks, things fall the way you set it: down, up, or nowhere. Needs a Core of Identity.
block.forgotten.marrowglass.desc: From the Underdream. It knows what shape it should be and grows toward it.
block.forgotten.memory_block.desc: A block of the Stack: memory nobody is reading.
block.forgotten.memory_vault.desc: Keep Memories here. It spends them to rebuild lost blocks within 16 blocks.
block.forgotten.null_block.desc: Past the addresses the world can hold. Things that pass through may stop existing.
block.forgotten.paradox_engine.desc: Subject, Contradiction, Result. It does not craft. It edits reality.
block.forgotten.possibility_eater.desc: Hunger + Possibility. Eats outcomes before they happen: monsters do not spawn and explosions do not go off nearby.
block.forgotten.possibility_sprout.desc: It has not decided what it will grow into.
block.forgotten.quiet.desc: A harvested absence of sound. Nothing makes noise near it.
block.forgotten.reality_anchor.desc: Pins the integrity of nearby chunks at full. The world remembers this place.
block.forgotten.rift.desc: Where an Infinite Loop fell through the world.
block.forgotten.rule_anchor.desc: Enforces one local law within 16 blocks: no PvP, no explosions, no monsters, or optional gravity. Use to choose. Reality Storms suspend it.
block.forgotten.scarred_netherrack.desc: The Nether remembers pain. This ground keeps replaying what happened here.
block.forgotten.singularity.desc: Gravity + Recursion. Gravity applied to itself until it pulls on everything nearby.
block.forgotten.sky_fragment.desc: A patch of sky, somewhere sky should not be.
block.forgotten.temporal_chamber.desc: Within 6 blocks, time runs four times as fast. Needs a Core of Identity.
block.forgotten.unremembered_block.desc: The world made this without deciding what it is. It changes its mind.
block.forgotten.unwritten_stone.desc: It does not exist firmly enough to break - except during a Reality Storm.
block.forgotten.volatile_log.desc: The trunk of a tree a creeper became. It still remembers exploding.
item.forgotten.architect_codex.desc: Use to read your rank, your debt, and the words you know. Crouch and use on a formation you built to speak it.
item.forgotten.block_of_air.desc: Bought from the Draft. Use on a block to make it air. It usually works.
item.forgotten.breakpoint_wand.desc: Use to pause everything nearby. Use on paused things to read their values; crouch-use to change them.
item.forgotten.cartridge.desc: A compiled program. Use it on a Bio-Node to load it.
item.forgotten.codex_fragment.desc: Torn from a fallen Architect's Codex. Read it to borrow their rank for ten minutes.
item.forgotten.coherence_shard.desc: Stable paradox. What is left when something is put back the way it was. The Mender's currency.
item.forgotten.concept_of_tuesday.desc: Bought from the Draft. Use it and it is Tuesday.
item.forgotten.corrupted_paradox.desc: Paradox that has started to contradict itself. Powerful, and it does not like being held.
item.forgotten.crash_core.desc: Set it into ground already at Fragmentation. Unmakes a five-by-five chunk region, permanently.
item.forgotten.destabilizer.desc: The Unmaker's first tool. Drives a chunk's integrity down and harvests the Entropy.
item.forgotten.dna_strand.desc: Use on a passive creature to splice it into a Bio-Node: its instincts are cut away and it waits for code.
item.forgotten.editor.desc: Hold a declaration in your other hand - a block, a chest, a slime ball - and point at what should change. It lasts a minute.
item.forgotten.entropy_shard.desc: Unstable paradox. What comes off the world when it is pulled apart. The Unmaker's currency.
item.forgotten.folded_memory.desc: A stack refined into a memory of itself. Weighs nothing. Unfolds only in the original world.
item.forgotten.git_reset.desc: Crouch-use to commit this chunk. Use later to roll it back to the commit, for 30 levels.
item.forgotten.glitch_grenade.desc: Throw it. Creatures swap minds, blocks swap places, players' controls invert.
item.forgotten.infinite_loop.desc: A program that never lets time pass. Nothing can run it. Something might open for it.
item.forgotten.lens.desc: Use to see how well this place remembers itself. Look at a formation to study the word it spells.
item.forgotten.lullaby.desc: Sing the world back toward sleep. For a while it forgets less, and leaves you alone.
item.forgotten.lullaby_shard.desc: Forms in the rock beneath places where you sleep often.
item.forgotten.memory.desc: What something remembers about being itself. The Paradox Engine runs on these.
item.forgotten.memory_of_the_first_world: The first thing the world forgot. Every Paradox Engine is built around one.
item.forgotten.memory_siphon.desc: Draws a Memory out of a block, a creature, water, or the open sky high above the world.
item.forgotten.nan_chestplate.desc: Its protection is not a number. Some hits do not resolve at all.
item.forgotten.null_shard.desc: A Null Material. It exists, but it should not. Found only where integrity is zero.
item.forgotten.one_gravity.desc: Bought from the Draft. Use it and you have exactly one gravity again. Usually.
item.forgotten.paradox_fragment.desc: A piece of a contradiction. Found where the world makes mistakes. Contradict a Memory with it to distil a Concept.
item.forgotten.patch_notes.desc: Read to apply a fix the world wrote for itself. Restores integrity around you.
item.forgotten.possibility_seed.desc: Plant it. It grows into one of the things it might have been.
item.forgotten.rule_scroll.desc: A rule reality has been convinced of, waiting to be applied.
item.forgotten.rule_scroll.lift.desc: Use on a structure you built to lift it into the sky. On natural stone, lifts a small outcrop.
item.forgotten.rule_scroll.sky_water: Rule: Water Remembers Being a Cloud
item.forgotten.rule_scroll.sky_water.des: Use on a lake. It rises into a floating sphere, fish and all.
item.forgotten.silicon.desc: Sand that remembers being thought about. Blast sand to make it.
item.forgotten.silicon_wafer.desc: The medium a Compiler Chest writes programs onto.
item.forgotten.source_code.desc: What is left of the Compiler: the world's own source. The Genesis Interface can read it.
item.forgotten.stitcher.desc: The Mender's tool. Rewrites a glitched creature or block back into what it should be.
item.forgotten.tomorrow.desc: From the Underdream. Use it and everything in this chunk advances exactly one day.
item.forgotten.undefined_sword.desc: Deals undefined damage: somewhere between nothing and far too much.
item.forgotten.unremembered_thing.desc: The world made this without remembering what it was. Four of them make a Paradox Fragment.
item.forgotten.unwritten_death.desc: Drink: for five minutes the world rejects the events that would kill you. Each rejection is a debt.
item.forgotten.unwritten_fragment.desc: Chipped from something that did not exist firmly enough to break. Only during a Reality Storm.
